text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product photograph on pure white seamless background, soft neutral studio light, entire items visible, realistic materials. No person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin, hanger, stand, typography, logos or watermark. A fitted black fine-knit mock-neck long-sleeve top, a subtle angular cap-like shoulder overlay that extends beyond the sleeve heads, fitted waist with natural fabric folds. Washed charcoal-black skinny jeans with gray thigh fading and brown topstitching tucked into tall black leather boots extending just above the knee, gently slouched shafts, asymmetric raised front tops, crossed leather straps with small aged metal side buckles, pointed toes and modest heels. Preserve the reference silhouette and visible construction. Clothing and footwear only, without belt, chain, fur or jewelry.
original_prompt: Reference defines clothing/accessory design only. Create one photorealistic product image, pure white seamless background, portrait 2:3, soft neutral studio lighting, realistic materials, whole item visible with margins. No person, skin, face, hair, braids, visible mannequin, stand, hanger, typography or watermark. Preserve visible reference design; do not invent decoration. One frontal ghost-mannequin clothing ensemble: A fitted black fine-knit mock-neck long-sleeve top, a subtle angular cap-like shoulder overlay that extends beyond the sleeve heads, fitted waist with natural fabric folds. Washed charcoal-black skinny jeans with gray thigh fading and brown topstitching tucked into tall black leather boots extending just above the knee, gently slouched shafts, asymmetric raised front tops, crossed leather straps with small aged metal side buckles, pointed toes and modest heels. Preserve the reference silhouette and visible construction. REMOVE all detachable accessories: no belt, chain, fur charm, jewelry, hair or braids. The jeans waistband is visible. Include the pair of boots as worn, whole garment ensemble at consistent scale, not separated panels.
reproduction_note: 依据用户提供造型图整理为纯白背景无人服装、独立配饰与完整造型。小尺寸耳饰和鼻钉细节、头发遮挡部分保守补全；不作精确款号或品牌鉴定。需保持设计时结合原参考，不承诺纯文字逐像素复现。
